shared_elements: repeated motifs arranged in a row
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces carved in low relief and organised into horizontal registers in which similar motifs (animals in A, human figures and trees in B) are repeated side by side in profile, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a single free-standing slab with crude, rounded, schematic animal forms and irregular register heights, while B is a monumental architectural staircase whose figures are finely modelled with detailed drapery, headgear and regular, ruler-straight framing.
